description: (App has been patched by Miguel without the use of newRetiled's servers) WindowsBlogItalia is the official app of www.windowsblogitalia.com, the first Italian blog focused on Windows 10, 8 and 7, Windows 10 Mobile, Windows Phone 8 and 7, Surface, Lumia, Office, Microsoft Account, OneDrive, Xbox, Kinect, and more! Follow us to read our reviews, discover stunning apps, tricks, and all new versions of Windows before the time! You can enable automatic translation from Italian from the Settings page. WindowsBlogItalia is an amateur blog and is in no way connected to Microsoft Corporation.
